declarations.description:
One band per series, coloured by the discrete state it was in over time: service health, deployment status, a
host's power state, a CI job's results. The normal state stays quiet so the exceptions stand out.

`series` holds the bands, each a list of segments with a `start`, an optional `end` and a `state`. Segments
without an `end` last until the next one starts, so a list of state changes is enough; the last one runs to the
end of the timeline. `states` names the values and picks their colours (`tone`); a value it does not list is shown
as written, with the next free palette colour. A `null` state marks a stretch with no data.

Mark one state as the `baseline` (operational, passing, on): it is drawn as a pale wash with no text, every other
state as a solid fill labelled where it fits, and each band ends with the time it spent outside the baseline. A dot
before each band's label shows the state it is in at the end of the range, and the legend gives each state's total.

Hovering draws a line through every band, and the tooltip lists what each one was doing at that moment. The
visible range is `start`–`end`, or the span of the data; times are shown in the browser's time zone. `markers` pins
events such as deploys above the bands.

The timeline is a grid: one Tab stop, ← and → move between the segments of a band, ↑ and ↓ between bands, Home and
End jump to a band's ends, and Enter fires `segment-click`. Each segment's accessible name gives its band, state,
times and duration.

members.name: series
members.description: The bands, as an array or a JSON attribute. Assign a new array to change the data.

members.name: states
members.description:
Labels and colours of the state values, in legend order; mark the normal one `baseline`. Values the data uses but
this omits are added after them. The legend lists only the states some visible segment is in.

members.name: markers
members.description: Events pinned above the bands, as `{ time, label }` objects. Those outside the visible range are left out.

members.name: start
members.description: First visible time: milliseconds or an ISO string. Defaults to the earliest time in the data.

members.name: end
members.description: Last visible time: milliseconds or an ISO string. Defaults to the latest time in the data; set it when the last states are still running.

members.name: hideLegend
members.description: Leaves the legend of states out.

members.name: hideSummary
members.description: Leaves out the column with each band's time outside the baseline state.

members.name: locale
members.description: Language of the axis and tooltip times. Defaults to the page's `lang`, then the browser's.

members.name: renderTooltip
members.description: Replaces the tooltip's contents. Return anything Lit renders, or `null` for no tooltip. Property only.

members.name: keyboardFocus
members.description: The time line and tooltip follow the focus only while the keyboard is driving.

members.name: rows
members.description: The bands as read from `series`: segments sorted, ends filled in and clipped to the visible range.

members.name: #clamp
members.description: The nearest cell that holds a segment, or the first one.

members.name: #onPointerMove
members.description: The time under the pointer, read from the first track: every track spans the same range at the same x.

members.name: #moment
members.description: The moment on show: under the pointer, else the middle of the focused segment while the keyboard drives.

members.name: #placeTooltip
members.description: Puts the tooltip beside the time line, on whichever side has room, level with the top of the bands.

events.name: segment-click
events.description: Fired when a segment is clicked, or Enter or Space is pressed on it. Bubbles.

events.name: segment-hover
events.description: Fired when the pointer moves onto a segment, or off the segments (`segment: null`). Does not bubble.
